title: Thirteen Of Forty Eight (One Delta)
style: infrastructure rap, terminal core, ops anthem, 92 bpm, dry kick, hi-hat 16ths, sub bass, deadpan delivery, status report flow, green LED energy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Pelican charters dot AI live on the VDS
Let's Encrypt cert green A record yes
Six-six-three bytes grew to ten thousand three fifty five
Site count twelve to thirteen of forty eight alive

[Pre-Chorus]
One delta this session one site moved
No assumption no fabrication just disk proved

[Chorus]
The line moved the line moved
One site flipped from skeleton to groove
Thirteen of forty eight on the board
Numbers not narrative is the chord

[Verse 2]
Constructor Vargas origin shipped seven four eight eight
Worker route at the edge serving generic template
Operator one action delete the route
And site fourteen flips no doubt

[Bridge]
DNS swap can't bypass a Worker
Workers run before origin lookup quirker

[Outro]
The line moved the line moved
Disk read no assume disk proved
